result.topic_en: A pencil draft written on a pre-printed form, mixing letter text (a request about speeding up the printing of his paper, a greeting, thanks for sympathy) with remarks on the form of an algebraic function f whose nth power, where n is the least common denominator of the boundary values, is a single-valued (rational) function; f is then expressed as a quotient over a product x_1 x_2 ... x_p.
